# Jayesh Soni - Portfolio & AI Product Engineering Directory

> Product Lead • AI Product Designer
> Designing AI products that align human behaviour, business goals, and intelligent agents.

## Executive Summary
Jayesh Soni is an AI Product Designer and Product Lead with 7+ years in technology, including 6+ years in UX and product design. Focused on Human–AI Interaction, Agentic AI UX, Conversational AI, and AI product strategy for LLM-powered, Generative AI (GenAI) products. Experienced in taking B2B and enterprise SaaS products from early concept to production, translating complex AI agent capabilities into goal-oriented, human-in-the-loop workflows that help people understand, trust, and work effectively with AI.

- **Website**: https://jayeshsoni.com
- **Role**: Product Lead • AI Product Designer
- **Specialisation**: Human–AI Interaction, Agentic AI UX, Conversational AI, Multi-Agent Workflows, AI Guardrails

## Selected Impact
- Drove Allyra.ai’s shift from an agent-building tool to an organisation-ready enterprise AI platform.
- Designed interaction patterns and task-focused, human-in-the-loop workflows for 19+ AI agents.
- Expanded Allyra's reach across 15+ organisations, including Fortune 500 conglomerate pilots, through platform usage and API integrations.
- Led a team of 3 designers and 2 business analysts; increased design throughput to 2–3 features per designer/week.
- Designed workflow automation for Tulah, a wellness and hospitality platform, replacing fragmented spreadsheets and manual communication with connected digital workflows.
- Delivered operational product experiences for Stanford Medicine, including the Financial Aid app.
- Speaker at TiE Chandigarh on AI and Human-Centred Design.
